_readme: Orion Drift master server directory. Commit this file to a PUBLIC GitHub repo and point OrionProductionBrowser > Registry Url at its raw link:
Keys starting with an underscore (like this one) are ignored by the client, so they are safe inline documentation. Strict JSON: no comments, no trailing commas.
Clients re-fetch every ~3 minutes and cache the last good copy, so edits go live without a client update.
Every entry is untrusted input on the client: invalid entries are skipped, rich-text tags are stripped, and hosts resolving to loopback/private/LAN/CGNAT/multicast addresses are blocked.
Use PUBLIC hostnames or public IPv4 addresses only. Hosts shown below are placeholders.

servers._note: OFFICIAL CENTRAL WORLD, probed with a TCP connect. ping.port is a TCP port that is open on the host (e.g. a health-check listener). It is NOT the UDP game port.
servers.name: Central World US-East

servers._note: OFFICIAL, probed with ICMP echo (UnityEngine.Ping). Works on most hosts but some networks drop ICMP; if so, switch to tcp or http.
servers.name: Central World EU-West

servers._note: LIVE EVENT, probed with an HTTPS HEAD request. Hidden after endUtc, shown but 'NOT LIVE' before startUtc, joinable in between. Times are ISO 8601 UTC. Only https URLs are accepted.
servers.name: Winter Cup Finals

servers._note: COMMUNITY SERVER HOSTED AT HOME BEHIND playit.gg. Empty host means tunnel-only, so playit is forced on. playitAddress is the UDP tunnel from the playit.gg dashboard. For latency, create a separate TCP tunnel and put it in ping.playitAddress; without it the node shows '--' and stays joinable.
servers.name: Garage League

servers._note: DUAL ROUTE: reachable directly, and also through playit.gg when the player's playit toggle is on. ping.method 'none' skips latency probing (shows '--'), but DNS and address safety are still checked before joining.
servers.name: Asia Pacific Open

servers._note: MAINTENANCE: listed (so players know it exists) but not joinable and never pinged. maintenanceMessage replaces the description line.
servers.name: Central World EU-West 2
